sources.title: Utah Lieutenant Governor, Office of Elections: 2010 General Election canvass by county (xls, sheet Governor)
Utah Office of Elections, Historical Election Results

method: pipeline/patches/2010_UT_GOV_special.py reads the Governor sheet of the state canvass workbook (county rows) with a standard-library .xls reader; the "D" ticket goes to dem, "R" to rep, and the Utah Justice (Anderson), Libertarian (McCullough) and write-in (Heath) columns to oth.
validation: CSV statewide dem 205,246 / rep 412,151 / oth 25,910 vs certified canvass Total row Corroon 205,246 / Herbert 412,151: difference 0 / 0 (0.00%). oth is 1 above the Total row because the Total row leaves the 1 county-reported Heath write-in vote out.
